verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas documents an Editor API for programmatically driving the Editor, covering scene manipulation, asset management and custom tooling. It also ships an official, npm-published Editor MCP Server that lets AI assistants modify project data and verify results in the viewport or a running app. A REST API is listed on the plans page. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of triggering builds/publishes programmatically (the REST API is only a plan-line mention), and independent hands-on corroboration of agents creating entities and editing properties end-to-end.
